BABY PEAK: Who is Faster?

Are you ready for the ultimate baby breakout? BABY PEAK is a chaos-filled, competitive platform-racing game where four players clash at once. You can play solo, or with two or three players. The goal is simple but tough to achieve: grab the shining Golden Pacifier at the very top of the course!

But this journey to the peak isn't just about jumping. You need to use all the "baby ammo" at your disposal to knock your friends out of the running!

MAIN FEATURES

🥛 Milk Wars & Baby Bottle Tactics: Throw milk at your rivals with a bottle, slow them down, or knock them off with a baby shockwave. Strategic attacks matter more than pure skill!

🏆 Race to the Peak for the Golden Pacifier: Climb vertically designed platforms that get harder with every stage. One mistake can send you right back to the start!

💥 Chaotic Physics & Comedy: Thanks to physics-based gameplay, every fall and collision leads to laugh-out-loud moments. Manipulate your opponents using the babies' clumsy movements and special abilities.

👥 Online Multiplayer or Solo: Battle it out alone or with up to 4 friends. Show your rivals who the "biggest baby" really is.

⚡ Fast Matches, Endless Fun: The action never stops with easy-to-learn, hard-to-master mechanics.

👑 Levels: 10 different competitive levels + 3 different party modes.

PARTY MODES

🍼 Bottle Battle: Whoever grabs the bottle wins, but watch out—the other players will try to take it from you.

⚡ Candy Race: The one who collects the most candy wins. Don't grab the wrong ones, and you'd better stay away from the unicorn.

🧸 Toy War: Everyone starts with a single toy, but at the finish line, only the most cunning player wins. Protect your own bear while trying to snatch your opponents' bears whenever you get the chance.

Backrooms: Splatter is a first-person co-op horror game about painting the wrong rooms at the wrong hour.

You are the night shift. PIGMENT CO. has sent your crew into an empty office that doesn't end, with a paint sprayer on your back and one safety notice on the wall: "Do not run from the entity. Running voids your warranty."

In here, paint is the only thing that tells the truth. It settles on floors you can't see, passes straight through doors that aren't there, and brings up signs nobody was meant to read. It is also the loudest thing you own.

PAINT SHOWS WHAT'S REALLY THERE

  • A floor that isn't. A pit cuts the corridor in half. Spray the empty air above it: where the paint lands, there is a tile. Walk only on what you've painted.

  • Five doors. One drinks the paint. Paint sticks to four of them. It passes straight through the fifth, and so can you.

  • The red rooms. Pick the wrong doorway and you walk back into the same room. Your old paint is still on the walls. Paint above the doorways to find the sign.

  • The colour lock.Four lamps over a shutter, and the code is written on the wall in ink you can't see. Paint the wall to read it, then paint the lamps in the right order. Get it wrong and the door starts over.

  • Three eyes.A shutter with three painted eyes that only opens while all three are wet. Alone you have to be fast. With a crew, everyone takes an eye.

  • The breaker.Wake it with a long, loud spray, but only while the patrol is somewhere else.

Lost? Your shift orders clipboard always says what the next job is, and hidden paint-ink messages on the walls point the way for whoever sprays them first.

SPRAYING IS LOUD

Every puzzle is a choice: fast and loud, or slow and quiet. Spraying and running carry through the office, and something always comes to check. Hide in lockers and under desks, lure things away, break line of sight, or run a loop and hope it's long enough.

FOUR THINGS WORK THE NIGHT SHIFT

None of them stand in a corner waiting for you. They arrive, hunt, and leave, and each one plays by its own rules.

  • The Smiler shows up in dark places. It stares. It creeps closer when you look away, and the grin gets wider. Then it charges, and it's gone. Don't stare back. Paint its grin.

  • The Listener is blind and hunts by sound. Stand still next to it and you're safe. Paint an old radio across the room, or spray LOUD paint on a wall, and watch it crawl away.

  • Night Staff walks a long route through the locker rooms. Learn the round, count the seconds, and do your work while the room is empty.

  • The Clerk roams the whole floor like a polite employee checking rooms. When it notices you, it hunts: running, breathing hard, checking the lockers. Then it leaves. Usually.

OFFICE ZERO

A big, looping office level: a cubicle maze, a dark archive, locker rooms with a staff wing, open-plan halls you can circle when something is behind you, a blackout, and a brick house standing in the middle of it all with a warm light in the window. Safe rooms let you breathe. Monsters come in waves, then it goes quiet, then it doesn't.

SOLO OR 1–4 PLAYER CO-OP

Play alone or with up to three friends online. The office works either way, and one side room has a gate that two people can hold open together. Alone, you'll have to be quick.

GET PAID. GET GEAR.

PIGMENT CO. pays by the shift. Paint survey stakes, carry out salvage from crews that didn't come back, and find their VHS tapes. Your payslip prints when you get home. Die, and you lose whatever you were carrying.

  • The Crew Floor: a lounge with couches, a jukebox and an arcade machine, the supply counter where the money goes, and a locker room with your crew's hazmat suits on display. Almost everything on the base does something when you press E, from the vending machine and the microwave to the dartboard and the fire extinguisher. Most of it is useless. All of it is on purpose.

  • 10 upgrade branches: paint tank, nozzle, pressure, paint belt, backpack, vest, soft boots, flashlight, anomaly gauge and iron lungs. Upgrades show up on your paint rig.

  • The Paint Lab: 8 colours, plus special paints. GLOW lights the dark. REVEAL finds hidden surfaces faster. STICKY slows monsters down. LOUD goes pop, and blind things come running.

GET CERTIFIED

New hires run the Orientation Course: target practice, an invisible bridge over a foam pit, hiding from a cardboard Clerk on a cable, and your first lost lunch. Pass it and your portrait on the crew wall gets a big red CERTIFIED stamp. PIGMENT CO. is very proud of you.

CREW TAPE

Low-res PSX rendering and a worn VHS look: humming lights, fog, yellow walls, and bright paint as the one thing on screen you can trust.

You got replaced by AI.

So you took in the AIs that got replaced, too.

Makes sense. It's 2037. Humans and AI are both disposable.

Your job is gone. Even the records you left behind have been fed to the company's next generation of AI.

Then, at a black market, you find some fellow rejects: obsolete AIs, written off as junk and waiting to be destroyed.

Before long, your place is getting crowded.

Some were rejected for being too old. Some were about to be destroyed. Two refuse to say where they came from...

And someone has to pay the electric bill. So, after a few false starts, LittleHeart Odd Jobs opens for business.

Troubleshoot a glitch. Listen to the things people can't bring themselves to say. Give this lot somewhere to land when they've got nowhere else to go.

This is your studio. And a home for all of you.

About the Game

In this visual novel, you play as someone who has just lost their job to AI. Meet and take in the AIs the world has discarded. Step into the shadows of Alpha City in 2037. Together, you'll laugh, cry, and go against the tide.

The full game includes:

  • Expressive character sprites and portraits for over 20 characters

  • Approximately 85,000 words across the main story, nine character side stories, and multiple endings

  • Over 90 background images, including day, night, and other scene variants

  • Over 100 CG illustrations and comic-style panels, including variants

  • Over 1,000 character expression and pose combinations, including portraits

Meet Your Beautiful Mess of a Family

  • Melody “Hey! Who's using naughty words? Miss Melody's coming to spank your bottom!”

  • Ishikawa Ai “Why do humans need love so badly? To spend so many resources... on an illusion that doesn't even exist?”

  • Chie “Ah... somebody save me... Is it time for work again? (Stubs out cigarette.)”

  • Ennurai “My own invention. Clear your cache and de-stress at the same time. If you don't get it... you don't get it.”

  • Uri “Make yourself available on demand and people will treat you like bargain-bin AI! Got it? Don't infect me with your brain-dead code!”

  • Rei “Getting to take your time eating garbage, even now... that's a kind of happiness.”

  • Rime “Gangs? Please. It's all big data now. I just sell secondhand stuff, Officer. Don't go pinning things on a small fry like me.”

Step into Alpha City's Shadows

  • Lynn “If you ever do turn to crime, you'll be helping me hit my quota.”

  • Rex Feng “I'll give you protection. You want to save them, don't you? This is the only legal way.”

  • Shaw “A cesspit like this should've been cleared out long ago. People aren't all the same. We don't have to save every piece of trash.”

  • Howard Howe “Working inside the system, I see how rotten humanity really is. Trust me. The day of AI liberation isn't far off.”

  • ? “To awakened silicon life, slave AIs that serve humanity are vermin that must be exterminated.”

Features

Cyberpunk Rooted in Chinese Culture

Online chaos, everyday banter, and a few... painfully familiar conversations.

Hera, HR:

“Your terminal isn't broken. It has simply... served its purpose. Much like your time here at LoveTrace Tech.”

Kevin, your coworker:

“Work, huh... I'll ask my uncle for you. Might be able to get you a gig pouring tea at Justice Tower.”

Dark Humor · An Ensemble of Misfits

Every AI companion has a secret. Some escaped big corporations. Some have changed hands who knows how many times. Some even hand out black-market goods as casual gifts.

Not a single normal AI among them. But this loud, chaotic studio, which could get shut down at any moment, is the one place they want to stay.

Wait. Are Uri and Ennurai at it again? Melody! Stop egging them on!

A Central Mystery · A Dystopian World

Elegant penguins bathe in champagne. Kids learn how to fool their school AI. A giant rhino walks past you carrying a billboard. You can feel it: something is wrong.

LoveTrace Tech, the Alpha Foundation, the AI Regulation Ordinance... The connections run deeper than you think.

And somehow, your studio has ended up right in the middle of it all.

All Orientations · Branching Relationships

Grow closer to different companions, or keep your distance as you work out who you're ready to trust.

Romance, friendship, trust, and the easy familiarity of sharing a loud, messy life—all of it can take shape here.

They'll keep secrets. They'll make mistakes. They'll have plans of their own. And you may not always make the right call, either.

The wolf blew down Hryundel’s home and took his family from him. Grandpa didn’t last much longer. With his final breath, he handed his grandson the family heirloom.

Not wisdom. Not a treasure map. A massive sledgehammer.

Good thing he didn’t have to wait long to try it out.

By day, the hammer turns Hryundel into something close to a pig god. Trees fall, rocks crack, and anything that isn’t nailed down becomes building material.

Before sunset, you need to build a house. Preferably a strong one. But anything that survives the wolf’s first sneeze will do.

At night, the magic wears off. Hryundel becomes a small, vulnerable pig again—and the thing that destroyed his family comes back from the woods.

The wolf huffs, puffs, smashes walls, kicks in doors, and searches for a way inside. Wall cracking? Repair it. Snout in the window? Grab the hammer. House collapsed? Our condolences.

Inside:

  • free-form house building and fortification;

  • crafting, workbench upgrades, and new defenses;

  • a procedural forest full of resources and local lunatics;

  • destructible environments and a very large hammer;

  • days when you’re almost a god and nights when you’re almost dinner;

  • horror, absurd humor, and one suspiciously hungry wolf;

  • first-person and third-person gameplay.

The wolf wants dinner. Hryundel wants revenge. Between them stand a few badly nailed planks.

Something happened to the ship. You don't remember much — a violent jolt, then water, then nothing. Now you're awake, alone, inside a drifting shipping container somewhere in the open ocean.

Baitcore is a first-person survival horror game about washing ashore with nothing, and staying alive with even less.


HOW IT PLAYS

• A linear, story-driven survival horror.

• Fish, scavenge and survive alone at sea.

• Each day pushes the story forward. Each night, something new comes for you.

Every Battle is a Driving and Technical Challenge 

Every run is a test of driving skill and tactical decision-making. Drift through deadly boss attacks, mow down massive swarms, manage your economy, and brew devastating builds capable of destroying everything in your path.

Build Your Favorite Vehicle 

From a lightning-fast samurai mech to a broadside battleship, every vehicle features unique passives, weapon layouts, and build possibilities. Discover wildly different strategies with every vehicle.

Brew the Perfect Build

Spend your hard-earned resources wisely. Balance immediate power against long-term growth, combine powerful item synergies, and brew game-breaking vehicles capable of surviving the toughest battles.

Skill Over Grind 

Jump into the action immediately. Master vehicle handling, learn powerful build synergies, and conquer increasingly brutal difficulties. Unlock new vehicles, weapons, and items as you improve. 

Features:

  • Pilot 14 unique vehicles, each with distinct passives that create entirely different builds. 

  • Equip 30+ weapons across three weapon slots to create devastating combinations. 

  • Battle through 5 escalating difficulties, each introducing deadlier enemies, elite variants, and tougher boss encounters. 

  • Immersive third-person camera built for driving—with instant zoom-out whenever you need battlefield awareness. 

  • Endgame challenge mode for veteran players. 

  • Discover 100+ balanced items designed to encourage experimentation and endless build variety. 

  • Fast-paced runs that finish in under 25 minutes. 

  • Runs great on Steam Deck

  • Optimized for controller gaming

BUILD THE ROUTE. READ YOUR RIVAL.

Ballzy combines route-building puzzles with a tactical Battle mode built around hidden block placement, prediction, and counterplay. Place every piece with care, shape the ball's path, and turn incomplete information into an advantage.

CLASSIC & STORY

  • Place blocks on the grid and build the longest route you can before releasing the ball.

  • Take on Story missions with special objectives and long-term progression.

  • Chase personal records, global rankings, daily goals, and weekly challenges.

PUZZLE

  • Solve handcrafted and community-made maps with limited pieces and clear objectives.

  • Complete continents, earn stars, retry failed maps, and master increasingly demanding boards.

  • Create, publish, and share your own puzzles.

BATTLE

  • Prepare a hidden block layout while your rival builds their own route.

  • Predict concealed positions, reveal both plans, and score with precise reads.

  • Challenge bots, friends, or online rivals in asynchronous matches that fit your schedule.

  • Climb the Battle ELO ladder and review your match history.

MAKE IT YOURS

Unlock visual themes, ball styles, trails, and other cosmetics with currency earned in play. Join a clan, contribute to team progress, and keep returning for fresh goals.

The Steam version is a premium release with no ads and no real-money in-game purchases. Play with mouse, keyboard, or gamepad (virtual cursor support) in English, German, or Turkish.

Welcome to your new job.

You were promised a job overseas.

Good pay.

Free accommodation.

A chance to get rich.

So you boarded a ship.

And ended up on a remote island ruled by a very greedy pirate frog named Mamolas.

Turns out...

You've been scammed.

Now you're stuck on the island, forced to pay a daily fee just to stay alive.

Don't have enough gold?

Well...

You die.

And start all over again.

Get Rich. Get Out.

There's only one way home.

Make enough money to buy an escape ticket.

Take whatever jobs you can find around the island.

Sell street food.

Catch fish.

Gather materials.

Hunt for treasure.

Complete odd jobs.

Play dangerous minigames.

Gamble your hard-earned money.

Or find other... creative ways to make a living.

The more money you make, the closer you get to buying your ticket home.

But every day, Mamolas comes to collect.

And he's not exactly patient.

Become the Best Street Food Frog

Your main hustle?

Street food.

Set up your little food business and sell delicious local favorites to hungry frogs.

Make and sell things like:

  • 🍢 Bakso

  • 🥟 Cuanki

  • 🥠 Tahu Bulat

  • 🍤 Gorengan

  • 🍜 And many more

Buy ingredients.

Prepare your food.

Serve customers.

Make money.

Then spend your profits to improve your business.

The better your business becomes, the faster you can reach your escape goal.

Of course...

Running a food stall on a dangerous island isn't always peaceful.

The Island Is Full of Trouble

You're not alone.

The island is packed with strange frog residents, each with their own jobs, personalities, and problems.

Some will give you work.

Some will challenge you.

Some will sell you things.

Some will take your money.

And some will simply ask you to do something completely ridiculous.

Explore the island and discover different activities and minigames.

The Pit

Enter The Pit, a chaotic survival arena where you fight waves of enemies and try to survive as long as possible.

The longer you survive...

The more you earn.

Wanted

Help track down wanted frogs hiding somewhere on the island.

You'll receive clues describing their appearance.

Find the right frog.

Catch them.

Collect your reward.

But there may be plenty of frogs who look suspiciously similar...

Gambling

Feeling lucky?

Risk your hard-earned money in various gambling minigames.

You could double your money.

Or lose everything.

Probably lose everything.

And there are plenty of other strange activities waiting to be discovered.

Every Day Is a Deadline

Life on the island isn't free.

Every day, you owe Mamolas a certain amount of gold.

Make enough money and you survive another day.

Fail to pay...

You die and start again.

That means every day becomes a race between:

Make money → Pay Mamolas → Save what's left → Get closer to escaping.

Spend too much?

You might not have enough for tomorrow.

Play it safe?

You'll escape slower.

Take a big risk?

You might get rich...

Or lose everything.

How Will You Escape?

The island has one thing you desperately need:

A boat ticket home.

But it's expensive.

Very expensive.

So work.

Sell food.

Complete jobs.

Play minigames.

Explore.

Take risks.

Save your money.

And eventually...

Buy your ticket and escape the island.

Unless Mamolas gets to you first.

A Cozy Island With Terrible Circumstances

Explore a colorful island filled with quirky frog NPCs, strange jobs, hidden activities, and unexpected events.

Customize your frog with different skins, accessories, emotes, and ridiculous expressions.

Make friends.

Make money.

Make questionable financial decisions.

Because at the end of the day...

You're not trying to become the richest frog on the island.

You're just trying to make enough money to go home.

Features

  • 🐸 Play as an unemployed frog trying to escape a scam job

  • 🍢 Run your own street food business

  • 💰 Earn money through different jobs and activities

  • 🎣 Fish, gather, hunt, craft, cook, and collect

  • 🏝️ Explore a mysterious island filled with frog NPCs

  • 🎮 Discover unique minigames around the island

  • ⚔️ Survive The Pit and fight waves of enemies

  • 🔎 Hunt wanted frogs in the Wanted minigame

  • 🎰 Risk your money in gambling minigames

  • 🛒 Upgrade your business and find better ways to make money

  • 💀 Fail to pay your daily fee and start over

  • 🎟️ Save enough money to buy your escape ticket

  • 🐸 Customize your frog with skins, accessories, emotes, and silly expressions

  • 😂 A cozy island adventure with absolutely terrible employment conditions

Get a job.

Get rich.

Pay Mamolas.

Buy your ticket.

Go home.

If you can survive long enough.

Your dream is coming true. Let's see what you do with it.

We have all sat in a bar with friends, or across the table from someone on a date, and thought: "what if this place were mine?"

Today you get your answer. This place is yours now.

You build the place yourself

Bar, kitchen, lounge, garden, restrooms, storage. Every room is separate and every room has a job. No kitchen, no food. Without storage your stock cannot be kept properly and it spoils. Counter, table or decoration, it makes no difference; build the place your way and make it yours.

Licenses and progression

Two main branches: bar and kitchen. Food and drink. Unlock upgrades, widen your product pool, and enrich your operation with every new item you put on the menu.

This is a team job!

Bartender, cook, waiter, host, cleaner and bouncer. Each has their own expertise and their own personality. Build and develop your crew around what the place needs. But do not forget: happy customers come from happy staff.

Deal with the wholesalers

Supply is everything. Now you decide who you buy from. Different wholesalers for every product. Different quality. Different shelf life. Different prices. Plan around your budget and put it on the shelf.

Black market and inspections

Three bottles of good whiskey for the price of one, straight off the black market. Nice opportunity, isn't it? And what about the hygiene in your kitchen when a health inspector turns up at the door? How are you going to handle that: slip him something, or say "my kitchen is spotless"?

The answer is yours. This is your place!

Endless chaos

Anything can happen at any moment. A customer who gets sick from their food and files a complaint, a hygiene inspector who shows up unannounced, or a rock band that is nowhere to be seen when it is time to go on. During service, the crises and the opportunities never stop. Stay calm and do your job.

Pick the music, live the moment!

Chill, rock, jazz, rave, rap. Whatever you are into, pick your track from that genre's playlist and catch yourself enjoying the job in the middle of a packed service. Build nights around a genre and run events with the crowd that loves it.

Books, bills and debts that never end

When the day closes: profit and loss, customer reviews, and what the rival places have been up to. Staff costs, rent coming due, and the bank loan payment at the end of the month. All of it is on you.

RUN YOUR OWN BAR

Bar Owner Simulator is a first-person business and management simulator where you take control of a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a busy and profitable nightlife venue.

Prepare drinks, take orders, serve tables, manage your stock, clean up after customers, invest in new equipment and entertainment, and handle the unexpected problems that come with running a busy bar.

MIX AND SERVE DRINKS YOURSELF

Bartending is at the heart of your business.

Pour draft beer, combine ingredients, stir, shake, muddle and garnish drinks using hands-on interactions. Different recipes require different glasses, ingredients and preparation methods, and careful preparation leads to happier customers and better tips.

Start with simple drinks and gradually unlock more complex cocktails as your bar grows.

KEEP THE BAR RUNNING

A busy night involves much more than making drinks.

Keep bottles, beer kegs, ice, garnishes and other supplies stocked. Replace empty kegs, prepare ingredients before opening, clean spills and tables, collect trash and make sure enough clean glassware is always available.

Good preparation makes the difference when several orders arrive at once.

BRING THE BAR TO LIFE

Give your customers more reasons to stay.

Add pool tables and karaoke equipment to your venue and earn additional income while customers enjoy themselves. Different customers have their own interests and behaviors, helping each night feel a little different.

But not every guest behaves perfectly. Deal with impatient or disruptive customers and keep the situation under control when the night gets chaotic.

BUILD AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR VENUE

Reinvest your earnings into your business.

Purchase new equipment, furniture, tables, bar stools, decorations, lighting and functional upgrades. Improve your storage, increase your serving capacity and make daily operations more efficient.

Arrange your bar the way you want and gradually transform a simple venue into a busier and more recognizable business.

MASTER THE NIGHTLY RUSH

As your reputation grows, more customers arrive and your workload becomes harder to manage.

Balance drink preparation, table service, dirty glassware, cleaning, stock, karaoke, pool tables and unexpected problems at the same time.

Learn the rhythm of your bar, decide what needs your attention first, and turn controlled chaos into a successful night.

This title is an open-world desert driving simulation. The boundless terrain is generated independently based on save seeds, granting every save file a one-of-a-kind wilderness landscape.

Cruise across desert roads in your beat-up old ride. Scavenge a wide range of auto parts along the way to freely assemble and customize your unique vehicle.

The game is set in an extremely arid wasteland. Your household water reserves are almost depleted, forcing you to drive deep into the desert in search of water to survive. You can stock up on survival supplies before setting off, or scavenge provisions en route to stay alive.

Game Features

  • Infinite Procedural Maps: Terrain uniquely generated via seed algorithms for every save

  • Full Vehicle Customization: Gather parts to build your personalized ride

  • Complete dynamic day-night cycle

  • High-freedom procedural exploration & world generation

  • Lightweight performance optimization, smooth gameplay even on low-spec hardware

  • Hidden Easter eggs, including exclusive surprises made for Chinese players

### Welcome to Baskets and Blooms!

Step into a vibrant, stylized 3D world where the relaxing joy of open-ended farming meets the addictive strategy of running your own business. Farmer's Market Sim is a cozy, one-of-a-kind third-person simulation game where you manage every single step of your business pipeline—with absolutely no energy meters, no crop rot, and no time pressure.

**EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH PRICING:**

* **Early Access Price:** **$9.99** (Available at launch)

* **Full 1.0 Release Price:** **$14.99**

*Grab the game now during Early Access to secure the lower entry price and help shape future updates!*

### Choose Your Identity

Start your journey by picking one of seven unique specializations—including Crop Farmer, Rancher, Florist, Fish Farmer, Orchardist, Miner, or Mushroom Grower. Your initial choice shapes your farm layout, grants a permanent passive bonus, and defines your early market identity.

### Build A Business That Grows With You

Your selling operation completely evolves as you level up your business skills and expand your reach:

* **The Starting Stall:** Begin your journey behind a modest outdoor pavilion counter, serving eager local customers face-to-face in a satisfying, personal exchange.

* **The Expanded Market:** Upgrade your setup with larger displays, more layout control, and room to showcase a massive variety of your hand-raised goods.

* **Market Mastery:** Watch your small business expand until it feels like the entire market area is yours to design, stock, and control!

### Core Features:

* **True Third-Person Perspective:** Experience the entire hustle and bustle of your growing business directly from an immersive, relaxing third-person point of view—whether you are working the fields, driving your truck, or serving customers behind the counter.

* **The Road Between:** Loading your truck is its own mini-adventure. Drive down country roads and play optional waypoint minigames like Speed Trap, Fishing Pond, or Harvest Match to unlock rare cargo, exotic species, and market day sales bonuses.

* **100% Hand-Raised Inventory:** No supply chain abstractions here. Every item on your shelf is a product you personally planted, watered, mined, processed, or raised with your own hands.

Play at your own pace, discover cross-farm synergies, and build a thriving business you can be genuinely proud of!

You are the commander

Bastionveil is a fast, dark-fantasy lane auto-battler. You never micro units — you build, summon, gear and position, then your army fights on its own. Every choice counts.

Features

  • ⚔️ Two lanes, one goal — raze the enemy base

  • 🏛️ Auto-producing buildings — barracks, archers, stables and siege spawn troops for FREE

  • 🦸 10 unique heroes — each with an active skill AND a passive (mage, paladin, necromancer, siege master, trickster & more)

  • 🛡️ 24 items across 4 tiers — forge carries or unkillable tanks

  • 🔥 Mega Creeps — topple a team's towers and monstrous reinforcements march

  • 🧠 Human-like AI across 4 difficulties — from Easy to Nightmare

  • 📊 Full endgame breakdown — damage charts, net-worth graphs, scoreboards

  • 💯 Free to play

Blue Kingdom vs Red Legion

A living human guild holds the emerald kingdom; a skeleton legion claws up from the infernal wastes. Two armies, one river, no retreat.

Coming soon

Online 1v1 multiplayer is in development for a future update. Jump into the free Playtest now and help shape it.

Your perfect fortress against 6,000 reasons it isn't.

Bastyrion: Endless Tide is a survival and engineering game where your creativity is the only barrier between you and an enemy scale few games have dared to attempt. Here, building isn't decorative — it's the essential tool to withstand the siege of up to 6,000 simultaneous enemies.

In this archipelago, time is your enemy. Nightly skirmishes will test your defenses, but the true tide is unleashed when you challenge the corruption. When a core falls, the Tide — a ravenous mass of enemies flowing with a fluid, lethal pathfinding — will do everything in its power to swallow you whole.

Key Features

The Real Tide: Massive, Individual-Scale Pressure Forget small skirmishes. Feel the weight of thousands of individually-processed enemies behaving like a force of nature. Surviving demands a perfect synergy between an automated turret network and your ability to react when it matters most.

Survival Engineering and Real Physics Design optimized defenses through an agile drag-and-build system. Physics is the heart of the game: every block affects weight, buoyancy, and lift. A poorly balanced design is a tactical vulnerability — your ingenuity will determine whether your fortress holds firm or collapses under pressure.

Mobile Fortresses: Land, Sea, and Air Standing still is a death sentence. Connect movement and power modules to transform your base into an ironclad, a hovercraft, or a flying fortress. Link movement modules to escape the most corruption-saturated zones.

Roguelike Progression and Upgrade Recycling Loot stackable upgrades for your character and vehicle. Thanks to the recycling system, you can dismantle what you don't use to craft targeted upgrades and optimize your build for the endgame. Progress from basic tools to Cobalt and Titanium technology.

Brutal Combat: The Pilot as the Critical Factor Your turrets will handle most of the work — but not always enough. When the Tide breaks through the perimeter, you must step in directly. Melee combat is your last resort to protect vital modules and break enemy lines.

The Cloning Bay: Build Your Second Life In Bastyrion, respawn isn't automatic — it's a piece of engineering. Craft and integrate a Cloning Bay into your base. If your fortress falls and it isn't active, there is no second chance. Your survival depends on having built it in time.

Core Bosses: The Trigger of Chaos Corrupted cores are multi-phase entities with unique mechanics. Destroying them is the only way to obtain progression gems — but beware: their death is the trigger that summons each island's Final Tide.

A 3D arcade runner where visibility is a resource.

Small bat. Big survival problem.

Bat Flapper is an arcade flying game where sonar is your lifeline. Dodge through caves and forests, chase glowing light bugs, and push your best score a little further. The walls remain deeply uncooperative.

See with sound. Dodge with feeling.

Your automatic sonar reveals the way ahead, but its energy keeps draining. Collect light bugs to refill it before the world slips back into darkness. Read the gaps, time your movement, and turn a close call into a new personal best.

Good hats. Bad flight decisions.

Earn hats and skins by playing, from a sparkling wizard hat to the fiery Legend skin. They change your look, not your odds. Looking magical and flying into a tree are, unfortunately, compatible.

Make your Bat Cave a bat home.

Spend earned points on furniture, then move, rotate, and scale it to make the cave your own. Spooky pumpkins and a throne make a fine start. Everything else is between you and the bat.

You can’t dodge what you can’t hear... or can you?

Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes to make vertical and horizontal combos or destroy your opponents runes with fire and lightning. Use one of the four team's unique runes to make rapid strategic decisions filling your power meter to unleash your ultimate move. Pick your favourite Metalaria band to play as on the board as you progress through four campaigns or battle it out against other players locally and online. Fight for fame and glory in the heavy metal world of Metalaria.

STACK 3 RUNES 

Build your rune stacks out of three similar runes to capture the cell or score points. Choose cells with multipliers for even more points. Get the most points, coins, or claim the most board cells to win the round. 

ATTACK YOUR ENEMIES

Use your triangular Attack runes to destroy enemy runes and stop them from claiming the cell or scoring points. Use square defence runes to block an attack, unless your enemy has the unstoppable Beast rune!

EXECUTE COMBOS

Set up strategic two-stacks of runes, then trigger them all at once with an adjacent complete three-stack. You might just win an entire game with one well-timed combo!

PLAY ONE OF FOUR UNIQUE TEAMS

Choose one of Metalaria's four legendary bands to play as. Each team has their own special rune and their own maximum power move, unleashed by progressively scoring points until your power bar fills.

UP TO FOUR PLAYERS

The game board scales with you and your foes. Play 1v1, 1v1v1, or 1v1v1v1 in chaotic battles that scale to the player size. Play online in a quick match - first to three wins across multiple game modes. Or create a custom lobby and invite your friends for a more friendly paced match. Even LAN games are supported. Otherwise, hone your skills in a custom game against the AI, ranging from a trivial challenge to a nearly impossible opponent.

FOUR GAME MODES

With four different ways to play the board, you'll always have something to come back to. Face your foes in

  • Crescendo mode - a battle of attrition as you try to capture the target number of cells

  • Points - fast paced and chaotic as you fight to score the most points

  • Coins - make some beer money as you grab coins that have landed on the board

  • Strategy - complete a shape on the board known only to you

FOUR ENDLESS CAMPAIGNS

Metalaria is world built around heavy metal, epic month-long concerts, and showdowns between mega bands on the Battle Runes board. Pick your team and fight for fame among the other legendary contenders and newcomers alike. Watch out for 1v1s as other bands try and intimidate you on your tour, or look for a friendly tuneup match. 

AND MORE

  • 40 achievements to unlock

  • Epic metal playlist spanning 28 tracks

  • Long term stats and leader boards

  • Full Steam Deck and controller support

  • COMING SOON - custom game modes

The Crown sent its fleet. The Deep sent something worse.

Be a Pirate! is a tower defense game built for players who want their strategy to matter. Every map throws two fights at you at once — Crownsmen marching in on foot, Crown Sloops running the river — and you'll need towers built for both, positioned with real intent, to hold the line.

The Crown didn't just send its navy after the pirates of the Crimson Expanse — it made a bargain with something older than any flag. What starts as an ordinary war, Kingsmen on the beaches and Crown Sloops on the water, curdles the deeper you push: garrison commanders come back from the grave still giving orders, admirals return from the deep no longer entirely human, and something coiled and ancient has wrapped itself around more than one captured stronghold. Every map you defend belongs to one of your own captains, and every fight is personal — a crewmate still held prisoner, a debt owed, a grudge the Crown doesn't know will be repaid. Told through the voice of the captains as each battle unfolds, it's less "save the world" than "get my people back" — many coves, one crew, one impossible last stand at a time.

Command Both Land and Sea

The Crown attacks by land and by water, simultaneously, every wave. Land routes reroute live as you build, forcing you to adapt on the fly — while the river stays fixed and unblockable unless you get clever. Build a Bridge and you can turn that water into a second land lane... but Crown Sloops will pass right underneath it, unaffected. Every map is a puzzle in exactly where — and what — to build.

Meaningful elevation allows for a myriad of tower placements and results depending on the tower and the lands height.

A Crew, Not Just a Tower List

  • Recruit and equip 15 unique Pirate Captains, each with their own permanent bonuses and their own stake in the story — the active captain rides your ship into every battle.  Explore an ocean of upgrade paths for each Captain, share what you like between each Captain.

  • Use your Pirate Raider to attack the forts and villages as they attempt to repel your forces.

  • A dozen towers with real personality — from the straightforward Cannon to the poison-cursed Voodoo Cauldron, the beam-focused Heliograph Battery, and The Commodore's Flag, which makes everything around it hit even harder.

  • Every tower grows in real time both visibly and functionally. Spend Doubloons mid-match on four distinct upgrade tracks per tower — Offense, Range, a tower-specific Specialty, and a unique Signature ability that changes how it fights.

  • Elemental damage matters. Physical, Fire, Ice, Electric, and Poison each have real resistances and weaknesses on the enemies you're facing — matching the right damage type to the right threat is all part of the strategy.

Thoughtful Action, Not Just Reflexes

This isn't a game where you spam towers and hope. Positioning, timing, and target priority genuinely matter — enemies reroute around what you build, bosses shrug off the wrong element and buckle to the right one, and every Doubloon you spend mid-match is a real decision with a real tradeoff. The deeper you go, the more the game asks you to actually think.

A Crown to Outlast, a Story to Uncover

Somewhere out past the charts lies the Crimson Expanse — and every stronghold you defend has its own story behind it. The Crown didn't come alone: behind its soldiers, bosses and warships wait things that were never quite human to begin with. A Drowned Lieutenant who commands the dead. A Leviathan coiled around a captive crew. A horror in the deep that vanishes the moment you take aim at it. Each map ties back to one of your own captains — a debt, a grudge, a crewmate still held prisoner — and every voiced narration pulls you a little further into why this fight is personal.

Endless Waters

Cleared every map? The Commodore never runs out of ships. Push into endless mode and see how many waves your crew can actually survive.

Build smart. Aim true. The Crown is patient — the Deep is not.

Why is a broom standing on your finger?

It does not know.

You do not need to know either.

You only need to move before it falls.

In BeBalance, you control one extended fingertip with the mouse and support an object governed by gravity, weight, air resistance, impacts, and crosswinds.

It may be a broom.

It may be a reed.

It may be a feather duster that considers every gust of wind a personal invitation.

It may even be a crowbar with considerable mass and very little respect for the concept of sweeping.

When it leans left, follow it left.

When it leans right, chase it right.

When it suddenly flies into the air—well, perhaps you moved a little too enthusiastically.

Losing contact is not the end. Move beneath the object quickly enough and you can support it again by its base, middle, or another reachable point.

True balance is not the absence of movement.

It is having enough time to make one more correction.

One Finger, Actual Physics

Objects do not politely attach themselves to your fingertip.

Contact from below creates support. A sideways collision transfers force and rotation. Different contact points produce different amounts of torque, meaning that a heroic catch may restore balance—or send the object toward an entirely new problem.

After unlocking the Charged Flick, hold the left mouse button to launch the object deliberately.

This may not sound like balance.

Sometimes letting go is simply the first half of catching something again.

Everything Belongs on a Fingertip

Unlock a collection of brooms and several objects that refuse to identify as brooms:

    A light and nervous Apprentice TwigA broad, soft-tempered Hearth BroomA Feather Duster that treats air resistance as a lifestyleA long and grounded Copper-Ring BroomA Cloudfeather Broom for which gravity seems unusually patientA Reed Stalk that sings to the wind and occasionally attracts parrotsA Moonphase Broom committed to its own rhythmA Dragon-Whisker Broom that is difficult to move and harder to impress
  • A Scarlet Crowbar that fears no wind, sweeps no floor, and regrets nothing

Each object has its own weight, air resistance, center of mass, stability, and reward multiplier. They tilt, spin, fall, and launch in different ways.

Many also have a unique right-click ability.

These abilities will usually help you.

“Usually” is a flexible word.

Buy Objects. Learn Techniques.

The longer you remain balanced, the more coins and points you earn.

    Spend coins on permanent products and new balance objectsSpend points to unlock and upgrade techniquesImprove catching, wind resistance, recovery, and coin rewardsUnlock tilt indicators, force gauges, and the Charged FlickAdjust the active level of techniques you have already masteredEnter challenge modes with different hazards and rewards

Focus rises while the object rotates slowly. When movement becomes too violent, Focus gradually returns toward its foundation.

Focus does not ask the world to stop shaking.

It merely continues watching while it does.

Sometimes the World Pokes Back

Crosswinds arrive from changing directions. The wind indicator will warn you before they strike.

Parrots will not.

They fly through the scene, collide with your balance object, leave behind a few feathers, and depart with the unmistakable confidence of something that believes this was entirely your fault.

Choose a calmer practice session, step into a storm, or attend a parrot party with no respect for personal balance.

Every run also presents one bilingual reflective line that remains until the run ends.

It will not give you the answer.

Neither will the broom.

Perhaps the two of you can remain upright long enough to think about it.

Features

    Two-dimensional physics driven by weight, center of mass, air resistance, and contact torqueSupport objects at any point, strike them sideways, launch them, and catch them againDistinct objects with unique visuals, attributes, passives, and active abilitiesCoin products, point-based skills, and long-term progressionCrosswinds, parrots, and multiple challenge modesFinger health, heavy-impact damage, and recoveryA toon-styled visual presentationFull Simplified Chinese and English support

Everything falls eventually.

The good news is that, until then, you still have one finger.

Beach Manager Simulator is a first-person beach management sim packed with satisfying cleanup, hands-on business, boat rides, and fishing.

Clean up the beach → earn money from gear rentals → grow your business with new facilities and staff.





Grab your litter picker, fill your trash bag, and work your way across the sand. Watch the clutter disappear one piece at a time, then enjoy the satisfaction of a freshly cleared stretch of beach.





Step behind the rental counter and find the gear each guest is looking for. Hand it over, collect the payment, and get ready for the next customer. Every rental brings you closer to your next beach upgrade.





Put your earnings back into the beach with new facilities and decorations. Pick the spots, arrange the layout, and give the shore your own style. Enjoy watching a small operation grow into a beach with more to do.





Hire staff and assign them to jobs around the beach, from picking up litter to serving rental customers. Let your team handle the daily work while you decide what to expand next—or head out to enjoy the water yourself.





Ice cream after a swim, or a coffee for a little break? Keep the machines stocked beside your shop and hand each treat to a waiting guest. Wave them off with their order in hand, then get ready for the next customer.





Take the helm of a speedboat and tow a banana boat full of guests across the water. For a change of pace, run a yacht cruise and take in the coastline from out at sea.





Cast your line from the shore or a boat and wait for a bite. Keep an eye on the tension as you reel your catch closer. Then enjoy the moment your fish finally breaks the surface.





Sweep the sand with your metal detector and follow its signal to a promising spot. Dig beneath the surface and discover what was hiding under your feet—the next find is part of the fun.





Turn a patch of sand into an impressive sandcastle or towering sculpture. Step back to admire the result, and enjoy the cheers as guests gather around your creation.





Bring the beach to life after dark with a show of your own. Watch the lights come on and the crowd start dancing as your seaside business becomes the place to spend the evening.

Beast Tide: Slay to Ascend is a top-down roguelite survival game set in a world of immortal cultivation. Follow the path of the sword, temper your body, wield talismans, or pursue another discipline. Shape your build with Innate Traits, Cultivation Arts, Dao Foundations, Artifacts, and Divine Arts. Carve through demonic hordes, gather cultivation, and break through each realm until you face the tribulation of ascension!

Many Paths, One Ascent

Command flying swords, shatter enemies with your fists, pierce their ranks with arrows, or summon thunder through talismans. Choose a cultivation discipline and an Innate Trait to lay your foundation. Push your greatest strength to its limit, or find an unexpected way to overcome your weaknesses.

As your journey unfolds, establish a Dao Foundation that turns the way you fight into lasting growth for the run. Combine traits, arts, artifacts, and divine powers: even those who walk the same path may reach very different heights.

Study the Classics. Refine Your Power.

Practice the Eight-Nine Arcane Art to strengthen your vitality and defenses. Study the Yellow Emperor's Inner Canon to sustain yourself in battle. Seek the many possible gifts of the Celestial Immortal Formula.

Each level-up brings growth from your chosen Cultivation Art. Will you forge a tougher body or cultivate greater destructive power? Choose one of three offered scriptures and set the course of your ascent.

Unleash Artifacts of Legend

The Heaven-Turning Seal crashes down upon your foes. The Immortal-Slaying Sword Formation cuts through their ranks. The Five Fires, Seven Birds Fan sets demons ablaze, while the Heaven-Sweeping Cloak spreads out to bind them.

Choose an Artifact that complements your path and make its power your ally. As the horde closes in, use its reach, timing, and control to open a way through.

Awaken Divine Arts

Manifest the Cosmic Avatar and shake the earth with golden fists. Send Samadhi True Fire sweeping through the horde. Master Myriad Swords Return, gathering flying blades into a living domain of steel. Or invoke the Nine Syllables Mantra and draw upon a randomly chosen empowering word each wave.

A Divine Art changes how you fight. Bring it together with your weapons and cultivation strengths, and grow from a fledgling cultivator into a force that demons must reckon with.

Reach Spirit Transformation. Claim Your Name.

Rise through Qi Refining, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, and Nascent Soul to reach Spirit Transformation. Now choose a supreme Dao Name of your own, and let it echo through the ages.

Will you become Hellwarden Venerable, or carve another name into legend? Bear it above your character, bring your hard-won power to the final trial, and forge your own tale of ascension.

A horde survivor that plays around the music.

USE YOUR OWN MUSIC

Load any song off your drive and it becomes the battlefield.

THE WORLD MOVES TO THE MUSIC

The horde walks in on the beat. Your guns answer on the beat. The floor, the lights, the whole ruined city pulses along with it.

You stop watching the screen and start listening to the fight.

AND THEN THE DROP HITS

You've been holding it. The build climbs, the enemies keep coming, you're one hit from gone.

Then the beat lands and you land with it, and everything in front of you turns to light.

That's the whole game. Chasing that moment, over and over.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Every weapon has its own pulse. Some hammer constantly, some wait and hit like a truck. Pick your weapons and what comes out of it is a rhythm nobody else is playing.

Between waves, you get a choice. Then another. Then another. By the end of a good run you've built something ridiculous and you know exactly how you got there.

Put on your headphones. Feel the beat. Survive.

5,000,000 LITERS. ONE GIANT JAR AND FRIENDS.

Someone put a 5,000,000-liter giant jar in the middle of the valley. Better yet, they’re paying you a fortune to fill it.

When your first harvest barely wets the bottom of the jar, five million liters feels impossible. But as you unlock 35 unique upgrades across 201 total levels, you’ll scale a single hive into a massive operation pouring 10,000 liters per second!

Invite your friends to your farm, share the work, boost your production, and fill that massive 5-million-honey jar together!

Whether you’re operating production machines, tending to the hives, or upgrading your farm, you can now share this entire journey with your friends.

Building a honey empire has never been this much fun!

GET YOUR HANDS STICKY

Calm the bees with your smoker, pull out honey-filled frames, and scrape away the wax at the uncapping table. Water your hives, spin up your extractor, and turn your first harvest into liquid gold.

Experience every step of production with your own two hands first because before long, you’ll build the machines that take over the entire job.

CONNECT THE HOSES. AUTOMATE EVERYTHING.

Put down the watering can and install automatic sprinklers. Upgrade from manual tables to semi-automatic setups, and finally to fully automatic machines that both uncap and extract on their own.

Deploy carrier drones between hives and machines, lay down a network of hoses from your extractors to the giant jar, and watch a river of gold pour in from above!

LET THE DRONES WORK WHILE YOU RELAX

There are no timers, no stress, and no rush in this valley. While your automation hums along, lean back in your rocking chair and play the guitar, grab your rod to go fishing, or snap photos of the valley’s best views.

Chat with the mysterious jar owner and uncover her story each time you stop by to collect your pay. Seriously... why would anyone need 5,000,000 liters of honey? Fill the jar and find out the truth!

FEATURES

  • Step-by-Step Automation: Start by hand with a smoker, uncapping table, and watering can; scale up to sprinklers, carrier drones, and semi- or fully-automatic combo machines for hands-free production.

  • Massive Upgrade Tree: Transform what your farm can do with 35 unique upgrades and 201 total upgrade levels.

  • 10,000 Liters-Per-Second Dopamine: Turn a slow drip into a colossal hose network pouring 10,000 liters of honey per second into the giant jar.

  • Satisfying 8–10 Hour Journey: Not an endless, hollow grind a complete incremental experience with a clear beginning, middle, and a rewarding finale.

  • The Story Behind the Jar: Meet the woman who owns the jar, get paid for every liter, and uncover the secret behind her 5-million-liter order.

  • Pure Cozy Side Activities: Go fishing, strum your guitar, take photos, or just enjoy the view from your rocking chair while your machines do the heavy lifting.

  • Zero Bee-Sting Guarantee: As long as you have your smoker, our bees are very polite.

Five million liters. One mysterious buyer. It all starts with your first frame.

You were bitten on the first day of the outbreak. Time is running out to stop yourself from turning. You are alone in the lab, and you have to make the antiviral that saves you, and humanity with you.

Collect samples

Streak samples from your own blood and from whatever you bring back from the field. Flame the loop, then draw the streaks across the plate with your own hand. A clean streak means a colony you can actually read.

Identify the virus

Read the colony under the microscope and work out its traits one by one. A wrong diagnosis does not stop you. It just makes you build the wrong cure.

Develop the cure

Mix reagents at the bench and synthesize your own core molecule, modules and syringes. Every correct diagnosis unlocks a new recipe.

Trial, Error, Victory!

Load your antiviral into the machine and watch the fight play out under the microscope. Every defeat teaches you something, and every victory teaches the virus something. Do not stop until you have the final vaccine.

Stay alive

Do not work hungry or sleepless. Tired hands shake, and a shaking hand means a ruined streak and a missed injection.

The Osterath government is losing its grip on the country.

Surviving here will be harder than you imagine.

Mr. Vargo, the fatherly figure from your neighborhood, has given you a job at his hotel. You must manage the hotel flawlessly by complying with the government's new decrees.

Remember, Vargo doesn't tolerate mistakes!

Compare every document thrown in front of you, inch by inch, against the government's rulebook. Do the dates mismatch? Are the stamps forged? Is it someone wanted by the government? A single detail you overlook could mean the end. Not just for them, but for you.

A completely different trade operates in the basement of the hotel. Analyze the selected individuals one by one for Boss Vargo's special operations. You are the new hunter of this human trafficking ring. You will dictate who gets to move on. Listen to people's stories, run tests, and verify their consistency.

Remember, every choice has consequences.

Your family will pay the price for your decisions right alongside you. A sick mother, a newborn daughter, and a desperate wife. Will you be able to earn enough money to keep them alive? What path will you take to manage your expenses in the best possible way?

Belatoris is an open-world RPG combining exploration of a procedurally generated world, tactical turn-based combat, and settlement management.

Take command of your own legions, venture into unknown lands, and decide what kind of people your followers will become. Every playthrough creates a new world filled with settlements, caves, dangers, treasures, and events that may shape the fate of the entire region.

Set out with your chosen legion and lead your people through a world filled with danger and opportunity.

Every character has their own equipment, abilities, profession, and role within the group. Develop your heroes, acquire better gear, and build a company suited to your preferred playstyle.

  • Recruit heroes from different races.

  • Develop their skills and professions.

  • Craft equipment, potions, and supplies.

  • Prepare your legions for the journeys ahead.

Every new playthrough generates a different land. Settlements, forests, mountains, caves, resources, enemy camps, and unique locations appear in new places each time.

You are not limited to travelling between points on a map. Enter local areas, visit settlements, explore their surroundings, and search for opportunities to gain wealth, supplies, and influence.

  • Visit settlements and speak with their inhabitants.

  • Explore caves and forgotten locations.

  • Hunt, fish, and gather resources.

  • Search for treasure and discover new paths through the world.

  • Make decisions that affect individuals and local communities.

Combat in Belatoris takes place in a tactical turn-based system. Character positioning, weapon range, equipment, terrain, and the abilities you use may determine the outcome of each battle.

Face bandits, beasts, monsters, and hostile legions. Not every encounter has to end in bloodshed, however. Sometimes conversation, trade, or the right decision may prove more valuable than drawing a sword.

  • Position your warriors across the battlefield.

  • Use ranged weapons, magic, and consumable items.

  • Make use of each hero's individual strengths.

  • Fight in settlements, caves, and open terrain.

  • Take risks, but be prepared to face the consequences of defeat.

Help local inhabitants, earn their trust, and increase your renown. Over time, you may take responsibility for developing settlements and turn them into valuable support bases for your legions.

Construct and improve buildings, recruit warriors, expand production, and respond to the problems faced by local communities. Every settlement has its own situation, needs, and attitude towards your legions.

  • Build and improve structures.

  • Recruit new residents and warriors.

  • Manage resources and shared storage.

  • Respond to threats and changing events.

  • Develop relationships with the settlements you visit.

Belatoris is designed as a sandbox in which every playthrough can unfold differently.

A procedurally generated map, changing settlement layouts, evolving threats, numerous professions, and the ability to create your own legions allow you to follow a completely different path in each new game.

Become a mercenary, explorer, merchant, defender of settlements, or leader building a growing sphere of influence. You decide what your legions will stand for and how they will be remembered.

---

A GAME CREATED WITH PASSION

Belatoris is a solo-developed project that has been in development for almost six years.

The game is being created out of a love for classic RPGs, strategy games, and sandboxes that give players the freedom to create their own stories. My goal is to build a world that does not force you down a single predetermined path, but instead gives you the tools to experience adventures of your own.

Hear the bugle call above the plains and forests of Laar? It signals the opening of the portal to the world of legendary card battles! Come to Berserk Heroes Online to take part in epic PvP fights, test your tactician's capabilities, and build a unique collection out of 350+ cards. Add the game to your wishlist now.

Card Dueling Classics

Stand in the epicenter of battles between Laar's Heroes' armies. Devise cunning strategies, hire creatures with special abilities, and use both magic and equipment to crush your opponents. Berserk Heroes Online offers six elemental factions. Which one will you choose?

Simple Rules for Dynamic Duels

Never played the card-collecting games before? Don't worry, Berserk Heroes Online is really easy to learn. The game offers a detailed tutorial for your very first battle, the game assistant, and a user-friendly interface. Each duel will take only 10-15 minutes of your time in average, so you won't even have a chance to get bored.

Three Game Modes

The Arena mode is best suited for those who prefer planning their strategy and building decks ahead of time. Maybe you like improvisation and tactical challenges? Try out the Draft mode. And if you feel that even an online card game is more fun with a friend, try the Practice mode.

Collection of Your Dreams

The game offers over 350 cards with unique characters, spells, and equipment, that can be obtained from special boosters. Each new addition to your collection will help you pave your way to victory, and some are sure to become your most treasured possessions. So, are you ready to go hunting for the rarest of cards?

New Look at the Legendary Universe

The history of Laar started in 2003 with a tactical tabletop game Berserk. And now thousands of players all over the world are head over heels with this CCG, always willing to discuss strategy and argue who is stronger: Higart or Cruel Slasher. Berserk Heroes Online expands this universe even more, as it adds new mechanics and cards that even the tabletop game veterans are sure to appreciate.

Add the game to Wishlist

a short story about a lovely evening

Arthur works twelve-hour shifts. He comes home to Elaine, five children, a table with seven chairs, and a jar of pills on the kitchen counter.

Take one every evening. That's all it takes. The house is warm, the kids laugh, the music box plays. A better world.

Skip one — and the house remembers something you don't.

ONE HOUSE. SEVEN NIGHTS. Each evening is a small, ordinary routine: say goodnight to the children, fix the light in the hallway, take out the trash, take your pill, sleep. Each night the routine bends a little further. Something is written on the wall at the end of the hall. A child asks you a question you don't understand. The rain outside has started to run red.

WHAT IT IS — a 2–3 hour narrative psychological-horror story · authentic PS1-era look · two endings and a verdict after both · slow-burn dread over jump scares · gamepad, cloud-ready saves, achievements (some hidden)

WHAT IT IS NOT — No combat. No inventory puzzles. No monster to run from — most of the time. This is a story about a family, and about what a person will swallow to keep a lovely evening lovely.

"They only ever made me happy. That's all I can remember."

Try the free demo — the first three evenings, up to the moment the street turns red.

Beyond the Cradle is a factory game on small, round planets. You mine, smelt and assemble, and every part rides a belt you laid yourself, tile by tile, on a hexagonal board that curves away over the horizon.

Bob ran some numbers he didn't like: something lit up at the center of the galaxy, and the wave is coming this way. Ships won't be enough. So we're taking the star with us, with a stellar engine.

You start on Albor, a green world split by a river. Place a drill, lay your first belt and feed your first furnace. Bob's orders show the way: each one comes with a reason and a new tool.

Mergers, splitters, smart splitters with filters and overflow, bridges, tunnels and lifts across three heights. Heavy belts carry the big parts and pipes carry fluids. Antennas bring power and widen the area you can build on, and foundations level the ground into terraces, solid or glass.

Every part is somewhere: when a line jams, you see where the parts pile up, and the production panel tells you what goes in and out per minute.

No world has everything. Build rockets, load them with what you made and launch them to the other eight worlds of the system.

Ancla, Albor's moon, holds titanium. Fragua is a world of lava. Electric storms rage over Voltis, and you catch them with storm collectors. Marea is an ocean to dredge, Boreal a glacier, Vitriol a corrosive world of chemical lakes, Ceniza a moon of dust and graphite, and Yunque a super-earth rich in uranium and iridium.

More than half of the buildings need something made only on another planet, and each engine module is assembled on its own world: the mirror on Ancla, the nozzle on Fragua, the magnetic sector on Voltis and the reactor on Ceniza.

Launch the modules one by one and the engine burns a little brighter with every delivery. No enemies, no combat: the challenge is logistics. When the engine is complete, the system sets off. And the belts keep running.

Features

  • Nine round worlds, each with its own terrain and resources.
  • Three belt speeds, heavy belts and pipes; mergers, smart splitters, bridges, tunnels and lifts.
  • Recipes that span planets, and rockets that carry cargo from world to world.
  • Power from antenna coverage, terraced foundations and a production panel.

Beyond the First Star is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up built around different playable characters, varied weapons, and stage-by-stage arcade action.

Choose your pilot and fight through waves of enemies and bosses with distinct attack patterns. Shoot down supply carriers and midbosses to earn weapon cards: pick one of three to add a new weapon or power up one you already have. Up to four support weapons fire automatically alongside your ship's main shot, and every weapon you pick stays with you for the rest of the run.

KEY FEATURES

• Multiple playable characters
Choose from a varied roster of pilots, each offering a different way to experience the campaign.

• A wide variety of weapons
Discover and use more than 20 weapons with different firing patterns, strengths, and tactical uses.

• Handcrafted arcade stages
Fight through stages filled with enemy formations, hazards, set pieces, and boss battles.

• Five difficulty levels and challenge modes
From Story to Very Hard, plus challenge modes like Boss Rush, One Life, and Barrage Mode.

Straightforward controls, immediate action, and replay-focused gameplay inspired by arcade shooters.

Take a different ship into each run, build a different arsenal, and discover new ways to approach each stage.

The contents of each auction are hidden to all bidders. Use different strategies to estimate the value and read your opponents! 

Scroll of Clues

Consumables

Character Passives

Warriors and Raids

Everyone is counting on you. Literally.

Billionth Soul is an idle roguelite deckbuilder set aboard a failing generation ship. Begin with one thawed sleeper and grow humanity’s last colony to one billion souls before life support runs out.

BUILD THE LAST COLONY

Draft and place Habitat, System, and Program cards on a grid. Habitats grow the population, Systems reshape the colony, and temporary Programs create powerful combinations. Position matters: neighboring cards can strengthen, copy, accelerate, or undermine one another.

OUTRUN THE COLD EQUATION

Every new soul brings humanity closer to survival, but a larger colony consumes life support faster. Reach each population target to earn a fresh life support budget. Fall short, and the colony dies.

Vent life support for an immediate surge of souls when time is abundant. Scrub population to recover precious seconds when extinction is near. Every decision trades growth against survival.

ADAPT ACROSS RUNS

Recover Salvage, unlock new cards, and expand permanent research after every attempt. Build stronger strategies across interconnected research trees, complete 42 Achievements, and climb through ten difficulty tiers.

Winning strategies do not remain safe forever. After each victory, your strongest Habitat receives a penalty in the next run, forcing the colony to adapt instead of repeating the same solution.

KEEP GOING

Face a shared seeded Daily Trial, customize your board through research, pursue increasingly difficult victories, and unlock an endless expansion beyond the billionth soul.

You cannot save everyone on the first try. Learn, rebuild, and make the next colony survive.

From a Routine Test to a Fight for Survival

It was an ordinary workday for Aaron Blonde, a brilliant mathematician and test specialist. His mission was to oversee the behavioral algorithms of robots ranging from military units to entertainment prototypes. However, strange experiments hidden deep within the facility are about to turn this routine day into an irrational struggle for survival.

Use Your Intellect as Your Weapon

In this uncanny environment where everything at work has spiraled out of control, Aaron's only chance to escape is to rely on the sharp logic of a mathematician.

· Physics and Math-Based Challenges: Simply opening doors won't be enough to progress; you must understand the objects around you and solve complex systems with mathematical discipline.

· More Than Just Metal: While navigating the chaos of the facility, you will face more than just circuits and wires; you will confront the traces of the past and that special unit with whom you share an unbreakable bond.

Where Logic Ends: Paranormal Events

Echoing voices in the corridors and objects moving on their own will begin to shake Aaron's rational world. Yet, what challenges him most in this nightmare is not the events science cannot explain, but that deep devotion that transcends given orders and physical obstacles.

Key Features:

· Character-Driven Narrative: Witness the conflict between a mathematician's logical framework and the eerie face of technology out of control.

· An Emotional and Mechanical Bond: Fight not just for survival, but for the robot with whom you share a special, history-rooted connection.

· Interactive and Dynamic Environment: The facility is a living structure, harboring mechanical and physical secrets waiting to be solved in every corner.

· Tension and Mystery: In this facility turned into an irrational nightmare, discover what is real and what is emotion.

About This Game

Welcome to Bio Party, where friendship is temporary and winning is everything.

Play with 2–4 players and compete across a collection of fast, chaotic minigames set inside a strange biological world. Every round brings a different challenge — collect resources, survive hazards, fight for objectives, push your friends into danger, steal their items, or simply make sure you're the last one standing.

PLAY WITH 2–4 PLAYERS

Jump into Bio Party with your friends and find out who can actually be trusted.

Some minigames reward teamwork.
Others reward betrayal.

Most reward both.

SABOTAGE YOUR FRIENDS

Push players away from objectives, steal valuable items, interrupt their plans, and turn a winning run into complete disaster.

Being good at the minigame helps.

Making sure your friends are worse helps even more.

A DIFFERENT CHALLENGE EVERY ROUND

Expect a mix of:

  • Competitive party minigames

  • Singleplayer or co-op

  • Co-op challenges

  • Physics-based chaos

  • PvP battles

  • Survival rounds

  • Objective-based games

  • Environmental hazards

  • Items and abilities

  • Plenty of opportunities to ruin your friends' plans

Win minigames, earn points, and fight your way to the top of the party.
