An interactive science-fiction detective story about a serial killer who commits murders through other people’s hands, using hacks that the police consider impossible.

A top detective from the narcotics division is forced to transfer to the homicide department. One of the first cases shocks even seasoned officers: at the crime scene lies a body with 68 stab wounds.

The next victim — 67 wounds.

The countdown has begun.

The maniac known as the Hacker leaves no traces. He hacks what, in the eyes of the police, cannot be hacked — and uses it to kill while remaining in the shadows.

The player deliberately separates different versions of events, recording each of them in the detective’s implant diary.

FEATURES

  • A dark detective story with elements of cyberpunk and science fiction

  • An interactive narrative with branching paths and multiple endings (≈70,000 words)

  • Choices that influence the investigation and the final outcome

  • A standalone entry in the interactive book series “Stories of the Robot NIS-AI577”

  • The ability to switch between languages and translations with a single button
    (useful for reading and learning foreign languages)

  • Experimental translation system:
    The game’s text was translated using multiple neural networks — ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and Claude.
    Switch between different translations instantly during gameplay and compare how each AI interprets the same story.

Can you find the killer and prevent the Biocybernetic Trap?

You're not the only one at this desk anymore.


Birch puts small, living birds right on your Windows desktop. Not inside a
window you have to open. On the desktop itself, where you already spend
your hours.

They get on with their day beside yours. Walking along your taskbar,
settling on your icons, dozing off, waking up again. And every so often one
of them notices you're there.

There's nothing to feed and nothing to manage. They just keep you company
while you work, and after a while the place starts to feel like theirs too.

Stay a while, and they warm up to you.


Spend quiet time near them and you'll start to notice small changes. They sit
a little closer. They react a little differently. Stay around long enough and
one of them might bring a friend.

Features


  • Multiple bird species, each with its own personality and way of moving
  • Interactive: birds react when you hover or click near them
  • Perches on your real desktop icons, not just the background
  • Dynamic behavior: idle, walk, fly, rest, startled, and more
  • Familiarity system, so the more time you spend together, the warmer they become
  • Unlock system: discover new species by bonding with your current birds
  • Multi-monitor support
  • Lightweight, runs quietly in the system tray and never gets in your way

Birds available at launch


  • White Cockatoo: sociable and restless, always claiming the nearest icon
  • Yellow Cockatoo: active and expressive, hard to ignore
  • Eagle: calm, deliberate, flies in clean straight lines
  • Owl sleeps through your workday and comes alive after dark
  • Sparrow can't sit still for two seconds
  • Chicken can't fly, but hops between icons with surprising conviction
  • Woodpecker is the only one that perches sideways on your icons
  • Toucan: hard to miss
  • Flamingo stays low and moves at its own pace
  • Long-tailed Tit: tiny, fast, never stops
  • Swallow almost never lands, and when it does it won't stay long
  • Java Sparrow is happy just to sit nearby, calm and compact

Always there, never in the way


Your birds stay with you while you work, but they never cover your windows
or block what you're doing. Open the settings or hide them all at any time
from the system tray.

HUMANITY IS GONE

The war ended a long time ago.

Machines conquered the surface, forcing the last humans to seek refuge deep underground. Before disappearing, they left behind their last hope: BirdBots, machines built around human brains, capable of reaching places where no one else could survive.

Now, one of those brains has awakened.

Fly. Survive. Discover what happened.



(Solo Survivor video gif)

YOU DON'T PILOT A SHIP. YOU FLY.

BirdBots features a flight system inspired by the movement of a bird.

Flap your wings to gain altitude, dive, accelerate, brake and roll as you race through tunnels where just a few inches can separate a perfect maneuver from a collision.

The controls are easy to understand, but mastering flight requires practice, reflexes and precision.

Reaching the end isn't enough.

You have to learn how to fly.

(Map 1 History Mode Video gif)

EVERY TERRITORY UNLOCKS NEW WAYS TO PLAY

Every new territory discovered in Story Mode expands BirdBots.

The environments, obstacles and threats found there also become new experiences across Survivor, Solo Survivor and Racing.

SURVIVE THE MAP. DEFEAT THE BOSS.

Each Story territory is a complete mission.

Explore tunnels, discover new areas, overcome traps and enemies, and reach the Boss controlling the territory.

But defeating it may require more than just flying.

(Boss Map 1 History Mode Video gif)

SOLO SURVIVOR

There is no finish line.

The world keeps generating ahead of you as the distance increases; new dangers appear, and every mistake could end your run.

No two runs are the same. The world is procedurally generated, including its tunnels, turns, traps, and obstacles, while following the theme of the territory you have unlocked.

Survive.

Beat your records.

5,000 m → 10,000 m → 15,000 m

And earn special skins by mastering each BirdBot.

MULTIPLAYER SURVIVOR

2–6 PLAYERS

Everyone enters.

Only one remains.

Survive the procedurally generated tunnels as your rivals fall one by one, until you become the last BirdBot still flying.

MULTIPLAYER RACING

2–6 PLAYERS

Race against other BirdBots on circuits built around speed, precision and mastery of flight.

The circuits are semi-procedural: their overall route and structure remain recognizable, while individual sections, tunnels, traps, items and enemies can change from race to race.

FLY. SURVIVE. COMPETE. UNLOCK.

Complete challenges to unlock BirdBots, skins and new customization options.

Each BirdBot has different characteristics:

Speed · Maneuverability · Durability · Control

And certain challenges will require you to master a specific BirdBot.

EXPLORATION & INVESTIGATION — UNCOVER THE TRUTH

The Birdbots clear the path. But what remains behind?

Once an area has been secured, take control of an exploration robot and venture into abandoned tunnels, now silent and shrouded in darkness.

Use your scanner to reveal hidden structures, investigate forgotten locations, and recover old recordings, VHS tapes, and clues left behind by humanity.

Discover personal stories, memories, and testimonies of the war against the machines. Piece together the origins of the Birdbots Project and uncover the secrets connecting each location to the next.

What happened to humanity? Is anyone still out there?

Exploration is an optional, story-driven experience. You can focus entirely on flying, racing, and surviving without interrupting your progression — but those who investigate will discover the deeper story behind the world of BirdBots.

THE TUNNELS WANT TO SEE YOU FALL

Floating mines, industrial traps, police drones, forgotten machinery and robotic creatures continue to guard facilities that have been abandoned for decades.

Each territory introduces new dangers, environments and Bosses.

UNLOCK THE STORY — UNCOVER HUMANITY'S PAST

BirdBots is more than speed, obstacles, and survival. Behind every mission lies a story waiting to be discovered.

Unlock character histories, recover lost human recordings, and uncover fragments of a world devastated by the war against the machines.

Explore abandoned locations, investigate hidden clues, and piece together the origins of the Birdbots Project.

Who were the pilots? Why were the Birdbots created? What happened to humanity?

The deeper story is yours to discover. Exploration and investigation are optional — you can enjoy the action without them, but every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

Is anyone still out there?

THE DEMO IS ONLY THE FIRST TERRITORY

The BirdBots demo is built around the first territory of the game.

It includes the first Story map and its Boss, as well as the first Solo Survivor, Multiplayer Survivor and Multiplayer Racing experiences based on the environments and threats discovered within that territory.

The full version will continue expanding the world with new Story maps, Bosses, BirdBots, environments and new variations across the different game modes.

KEY FEATURES

  • Skill-based arcade flight built around wing flapping and altitude control.

  • A science-fiction campaign featuring unique maps and Boss encounters.

  • Procedurally generated Solo Survivor.

  • Multiplayer Survivor for 2–6 players.

  • Multiplayer Racing for 2–6 players.

  • Steam-based multiplayer lobbies.

  • BirdBots with different flight characteristics.

  • Unlockable BirdBots and skins earned through challenges.

  • Post-apocalyptic environments filled with mechanical enemies and traps.

  • Progression connecting Story Mode with the other game modes.

  • Original soundtrack.

ONE PLAYER. ONE CAREER.
You're on the pitch, making the decisions. Find space, shout for the ball with a quick “HEY!”, and make your next touch count. Pass, dribble or shoot — your performance shapes your reputation, your place in the team and the opportunities ahead.

FROM THE BENCH TO THE FLOODLIGHTS
Your career starts on the bench at a third- or fourth-division club, depending on the offer you accept. Make an impact as a substitute, earn a starting shirt and attract attention from bigger clubs. Work your way from village grounds with wooden benches and fans behind the fence to towering stands, LED boards and floodlit stadiums.

EVERY CAREER IS ITS OWN WORLD
Step into a football world of its own: four divisions, 74 fictional clubs and fresh rivalries to discover. Each club has its own crest, colours, hometown and home ground. Meet new title contenders, find an unlikely favourite and build your own history with the clubs you represent.

THE SCOUT SEES EVERYTHING
Twenty visible abilities — including pace, dribbling, shooting, first touch and positioning — develop alongside eight hidden attributes, such as ambition, sportsmanship, teamwork and bravery. Your performances and character influence how clubs see you. After each match, your coach gives feedback based on what you actually did on the pitch.

TRAIN. IMPROVE. EARN YOUR PLACE.
Work on your finishing, free kicks, crossing, passing and dribbling between matches. Build your abilities over time and turn practice into better performances. A brilliant match can get you noticed; lasting progress takes work.

REAL FOOTBALL ON THE PITCH
Charge your shots, add curl, beat defenders with sharp changes of direction and time your sliding tackles. Attack crosses with headers — or attempt a bicycle kick with your back to goal. Teammates keep their shape, make supporting runs and deliver crosses, while goalkeepers react to shots and close down dangerous situations. Offside, corners, throw-ins, yellow and red cards, referees and linesmen complete the match.

FROM CLUB TO COUNTRY
Chase league titles and cup trophies, then aim for international football. Strong performances can earn a national-team call-up and a chance to reach the World Cup. Represent your home nation, or become eligible for your adopted country after several seasons and choose a new international path.

WEATHER THAT MATTERS
Play through sunny afternoons, floodlit evenings, rain, storms, fog and snow. Changing light, weather and pitch conditions give matches their own atmosphere, from a muddy lower-league ground to a night under the stadium lights.

LIFE OFF THE PITCH
Spend your wages on houses and cars, from your first modest home to a two-storey villa. View your purchases in full-screen 3D scenes and watch your player enjoy life away from the stadium.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play with keyboard and mouse or a controller, choose from 28 interface languages and pursue 32 Steam achievements. Steam Cloud supports your career saves, photos and replays.

Enjoy a relaxing idle incremental experience centered around growing and evolving a powerful black hole. The infected are closing in. Turn their plague against them.

Black Hollow is a first-person dark fantasy horde-survival roguelite. Take up the plague doctor's staff and face the hunt solo or in up to four-player online co-op.





Hunt across Black Hollow, Ashen Abbey, Mournwater and Cinderwatch Foundry. From the abbey to the foundry, learn each hunting ground and find room to fight.





Strike with your staff, hurl volatile flasks and unleash plague-powered abilities. Combine attacks and wards, manage your openings and keep moving as the crowd closes in.





Earn relic choices during the hunt and shape a build around the powers you pick. Find combinations that change how you fight, then put them to work against the next wave.





The hunt does not end with one run. Invest in permanent upgrades at the Ichor Codex and return with new ways to strengthen your doctor.





The night keeps moving, and the pressure keeps rising. Hold your ground against the infected, make space when you need it and keep your build alive through the escalating hunt.



The free demo is single-player.

Devour the Universe in Blackhole Collapse

Take control of a stationary rogue singularity and unleash cosmic destruction! Blackhole Collapse is an intense action rogue-lite where your primary weapon is your absolute gravitational pull.

Key Features

• Absorb & Grow: Start as a tiny anomaly in deep space and devour asteroids, energy fields, and cosmic debris to expand into an unstoppable cosmic force.

• Defend the Event Horizon: You cannot run. Hold your ground as swarms of volatile hazards close in from all 360 degrees. Master your hold-and-release timing to unleash devastating omnidirectional blasts, and use split-second "Perfect Pulse" counters to turn an enemy's hit into a devastating payback blast.




• Build Your Singularity: Unlock powerful gravitational abilities, passive upgrades, and game-breaking perk synergies on every run to customize your destructive potential.




• Face the Elites: Every stage escalates into dangerous elite anomalies—rare, massive enemies that will test the absolute limits of your build.

BLACKBEAM is a top-down sci-fi action adventure combining exploration, combat, crystal mining, and light base building.


Take control of a rover and traverse the surface of an alien planet. Discover new areas, smash crystal formations, battle hostile creatures, and venture ever farther in search of valuable resources and extraordinary finds.


By day, the world favors exploration and growth. After dark, visibility drops sharply, energy becomes more important, and the surface grows far more dangerous. You can return to the safety of your base facilities or stay out in the field and take a greater risk.


SET OUT ON EXPEDITIONS
Drive your rover across an alien world, discover new places, and venture ever farther from your base. Every expedition may lead to new deposits, dangerous areas, and valuable finds.


SMASH AND MINE CRYSTALS
Find formations of alien crystals and smash them to gather the resources you need to progress. Better equipment will let you reach increasingly valuable deposits and mine them more effectively.


BATTLE ALIEN WILDLIFE
You are not alone on the surface. Evade attacks, use your rover's weapons, and battle creatures encountered while exploring. After night falls, they become a far greater threat.


UPGRADE YOUR ROVER AND BASE FACILITIES
Improve your rover's capabilities to travel farther, extract resources more efficiently, and handle threats more effectively. Expand your base and build the facilities you need to prepare for future expeditions.


MAKE THE MOST OF THE DAY. RISK THE NIGHT.
Daylight makes exploration, mining, and preparation easier. After dark, limited visibility, greater energy demands, and hostile activity change the rhythm of play. Returning to base is safer, but pressing on may be worth the risk.


VENTURE EVER FARTHER
Gather resources, improve your equipment, and expand your expedition's capabilities. With every upgrade, you can venture farther into the unknown and face increasingly challenging regions of the planet.


PLAY SOLO OR ONLINE
Explore the planet alone or enter an online world where the presence of other players brings added unpredictability, competition, and new threats.

Pack Carefully. The Road Remembers.

The Plague-Father crawled out of the Hamlet's well. Hounds run the Forest of Hangings. The Black Cathedral has gone silent, and silence on this road is the loudest warning.

You lead three mercenaries. You have no perfect plan. You have what you find.

A GAME ABOUT WHERE THINGS GO

Every item you recover must be physically placed into a mercenary's 4x4 inventory grid. A cleaver beside oil can become a sweeping strike. Greekfire beside a torch can turn a pack into a weapon. Holy relics, cursed charms, armor, food, tools, and blades all change depending on what they touch.

Your inventory is not storage. It is your character sheet.

PACKS BECOME TACTICS

Combat is turn-based, compact, and lethal. Move across small tactical grids, protect the wounded, and use the abilities your pack unlocked before the fight began. A good build gives you options. A desperate build gives you stories.

CHOOSE THREE DOOMED MERCENARIES

Build each run around a three-person warband chosen from nine mercenary archetypes, including the Witch-hunter, Plague Doctor, Templar, Apostate, Sin-eater, Bone-Setter, Hollow Bride, Flagellant, and Gallows-Born.

Each mercenary has different stats, item restrictions, starting gear, and build hooks. Some thrive on armor. Some weaponize poison. Some make cursed objects look almost reasonable.

THREE REGIONS. THREE BOSSES. NO CLEAN VICTORIES.

Travel through the Plagued Hamlet, the Forest of Hangings, and the Black Cathedral. Each region brings its own enemies, encounter tables, items, and boss.

Death ends the run, but not the work. Relics, achievements, and unlocks return to the Hideout, where you open new gear, new mercenary options, and new ways to build the next doomed expedition.

FEATURES

  • Spatial inventory roguelite tactics: every mercenary has a 4x4 pack

  • 98 items across blades, armor, holy relics, cursed objects, alchemy, tools, food, and relics

  • Adjacency combos that create combat abilities, passive bonuses, poison, burn, revive, block, curse, and more

  • 9 mercenary archetypes with distinct build identities

  • 24 enemies and 3 major bosses across 3 hand-authored regions

  • Branching run map with combat, shop, event, shrine, and boss nodes

  • Permadeath runs with persistent unlocks through the Hideout

  • 53 achievement/trophy hooks and signature gear rewards

  • Singleplayer, turn-based, 2D, built for repeated tactical runs

EARLY ACCESS

Blackbriar Crypt is planned for Early Access so player feedback can shape balance, item synergies, unlock pacing, and late-run difficulty.

The current target includes the core run loop, three regions, three bosses, nine mercenaries, nearly one hundred items, achievements, audio, accessibility settings, and Steam integration. Early Access will focus on tuning, usability, controller/Steam Deck polish, localization quality, and additional content where it improves the core inventory puzzle.

The Signal controls the world. You are part of the Resistance.

SHUT DOWN THE SIGNAL — AND MAKE IT BACK.

The main objective of every raid is to locate and shut down a Signal belonging to the Synchronization Network.

Once the Signal is disabled, the Network detects your presence and activates its destruction protocol.

Every raid takes you to a new location where Signals are still active.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE AND VENTURE INTO INFECTED ZONES.

THE CAMP

This is the Resistance’s base of operations.

Here, you can sell the loot you find to traders, salvage resources, craft new gear, and prepare for your next run.

Upgrade and defend your base against raids by the Network’s Agents.

The Synchronization Network never forgets those who interfere with its operations.

Sometimes, the Signals will track down your hideout, and Network Agents will attack your camp — forcing you to defend everything you’ve built.

Fortify your base and be ready for an assault.

BLACKOUT ROUTE — Add it to your WISHLIST NOW and become part of the RESISTANCE.

Features

  • Explosive arcade combat racing

  • 24 hand-crafted tracks across three distinct environments

  • 10 unique cars with unlockable paint jobs

  • Upgrade your car between races with weapons and performance improvements

  • Chaotic 4-player splitscreen multiplayer

  • Championship, Single Race, Time Trial and Blastlane Academy

  • Dangerous tracks packed with jumps, hazards and dynamic elements

Classic Arcade Combat Racing Reimagined

Blastlane Racers brings back the spirit of classic top-down combat racers and reimagines it with modern visuals and explosive gameplay.

Boost past your opponents, unleash powerful weapons and outmaneuver rivals on dangerous tracks packed with jumps, hazards and dynamic elements. Every race is a chaotic battle where skillful driving and clever upgrades decide who reaches the finish line first.

Upgrade Your Car Between Races

Earn prize money by winning races and destroying rivals throughout the championship.

Between races, visit the shop to improve your car with performance upgrades, stronger armor and powerful weapons. Choose carefully and build a machine that fits your driving style.

Race, Earn Progress, Unlock Paint Jobs

Choose from 10 different cars, each with its own handling characteristics.

Whatever mode you play, you're always making progress. Earn points by racing, finishing in higher positions, taking on tougher difficulties and destroying rivals.

Unlock two additional paint jobs for every car – and prove you've mastered your favorite ride by winning a Championship on the highest difficulty to unlock its exclusive gold paint job.

Chaotic 4-Player Splitscreen

Blastlane Racers is built for couch competition.

Challenge your friends in 4-player splitscreen races where rockets fly, cars explode and victories are often decided in the final corner.

Perfect for chaotic multiplayer sessions.

24 Hand-Crafted Tracks

Race across tropical islands, forests and mountain roads, and urban race arenas.

Every track is built by hand and brings its own layouts, jumps, hazards and dynamic elements. Learn the shortcuts, master the dangerous sections and find the fastest way through all 24 tracks.

More Ways to Race

Take on an entire Championship, jump straight into the action in Single Race, or chase your fastest laps in weapon-free Time Trial.

New to Blastlane Racers? Head to the Blastlane Academy to learn the controls, master your driving skills and train with the game's weapons through a series of short challenges.

Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢 is a first-person psychological horror game about grief, trauma, and fractured memories, infused with unsettling religious symbolism.

Each chapter is a new nightmare to escape from. Explore an abandoned chapel that slowly transforms into surreal dreamscapes, forgotten hospital wards, and impossible places where painful memories refuse to stay buried.

Play as Jeremyah, a disturbed young man shaped by his trauma. Piece together the devastating family tragedy that broke you, through exploration, environmental storytelling, and disturbing supernatural encounters. 

FEATURES

  • A deeply emotional psychological horror story

112 smoothie weapons. Build your combo.

A blender, a crowd of food monsters, and a recipe worth trying. Craft smoothie weapons, discover how they interact, and take your build bounty hunting.

Pick a recipe. Change your attack.

Cherry and peach make a flamethrower. Banana and peach make a tornado. Apple and melon make a cutting beam. Hunt ingredient Elites, collect their drops, and craft the weapons you want to try.

Three recipes, three different attacks.

Give your weapons a partner.

A Peach Bloom fires small buds on its own. With an active shield, it unfolds into a much larger spinning flower. Choose cups for what they do together, not just what they do alone.

First: no shield. Then: an active shield opens the flower.

Feed a bigger splash.

Pair Grape Yogurt with a weapon that leaves yogurt on the ground. With yogurt nearby, its small shot becomes a larger splash on impact. Equip up to six cups at once and find room for the combinations you want.

First: the small shot. Then: yogurt powers the larger splash.

Take the contract. Bring your build.

Choose a bounty and fight through its island route. Gather ingredients, pick upgrades, and visit the Smoothie Shop before facing your target. Defeat the boss, claim Ruby Berries, and try another hunt with a different loadout.

The boss is the test your build has been preparing for.

"Follow Nex Crowmont and his friends who get pulled into the city’s unraveling…"

Step into the role of a paranormal investigator in Blightsilver. Navigate freely through haunted locations. Uncover hidden events, solve puzzles, and piece together fragments of lore as mysteries grip the city.

Grow your card collection and build your own deck. Duel on a hidden 5×5 grid, where every face-down card might be a lie. Push too hard on offense and you leak information; lean too hard on defense and you become easy prey. Hide your best cards, strip away what your opponent conceals, and break them when the grid opens up.

Different anomalies require different paranormal tools. Use correct tools to expose and vanish them with power of the deck you crafted.

Nex Crowmont

  • A 20-year-old, perpetually exhausted university student who coasts through classes on heavy sighs and zero effort. He’d rather spend his days napping and avoiding any thoughts about his future. Despite being good-for-nothing, he is a fair person and always has empathy for other people. He is talented with his photographic memory, but mostly used for nonsense stuffs anyway.

In an easygoing city where everything seems low-key, it was once a place rife with rumors about strange phenomena happening here and there. As the city developed, those rumors were forgotten. Universities, hospitals, and shopping districts sprouted up, leaving its infamous past behind.

Until one day, two university students, Nex and Mayu, stumbled onto the wrong side of luck and got their first taste of surviving an anomaly attack. With help from a mysterious stranger, they received cards imbued with exorcism powers, leading them toward their destiny as anomaly investigators.​

FOLLOW THE VOICE YOU TRUST ON A PATH YOU CANNOT SEE.

BlindRoute is a sci-fi 3D puzzle platformer built around communication, trust, and quick decisions. Blind and Guide players experience the same route with different information. Describe what you see, trust what you hear, and move as one team.

TWO DISTINCT ROLES

Blind players cannot see the safe route. They must rely on their Guides to identify platforms, hazards, and the correct direction.

Guide players study the route, detect danger, and lead their Blind teammate to safety. Not every role receives the same information, making clear communication the key to survival.

CHANGING ROUTES AND HAZARDS

• Complete procedurally generated sci-fi routes.

• Collect keys, open real gates, and watch out for deceptive paths.

• Overcome moving and rotating platforms, elevators, and physics-based hazards.

• Reach checkpoints while carefully managing your limited lives.

• Push opponents and disrupt rival teams to gain an advantage.

PLAY ALONE OR AS A TEAM

• Complete solo routes as a Guide.

• Cooperate in teams built around Blind and Guide roles.

• Race rival teams across the same dangerous course.

• Compete in solo Guide races and 4v4 team matches.

• Create private lobbies with friends or join online matchmaking.

YOUR VOICE IS YOUR TEAM'S MOST IMPORTANT TOOL

Built-in team voice chat keeps every warning and direction close at hand. Listen to positional environmental audio, locate moving hazards, and trust your team in the darkness.

Build Your City Block by Block

Start from a small district and grow outward into a denser, livelier city.

Buildings must be placed next to your existing city, every new block becomes part of a bigger layout. Your streets, neighborhoods, parks, shops, and industry all grow together into one connected place.

Earn Points Through Smart Synergies

Smart placement is the heart of the game.

Parks, homes, shops, and industry all affect each other in different ways. A strong placement can earn back its cost and more, while a weak one can slow your progress.

Unlock New Tools at the Town Hall

Unlock new building types and upgrade tiers in the Town Hall.

Early decisions help you reach the next unlock, and each unlock gives you more ways to shape stronger layouts.

Expand by Completing Puzzles

Each new tile is a small city-building puzzle.

To unlock more land, you need to meet the building requirements. That means balancing what your city needs next with where it should go, then pushing outward as new land rises from the water.

Upgrade your Buildings

A well-placed upgraded building can improve the blocks around it, help fuel future placements, and visibly transform part of your city into something bigger and more impressive.

Grow a Warm, Living City

Pedestrians move through the streets, lights glow across the skyline, fog and time of day change the mood, and each new block helps the city feel fuller, warmer, and more complete.

Block By Block Tycoon is built for players who enjoy relaxed strategy, satisfying optimization, and the feeling of watching a city slowly come to life.

Features

  • Build a connected city block by block from a small starting district

  • Earn points through smart placement

  • Use synergies between building types to create stronger layouts

  • Unlock new building types and upgrade tiers at the Town Hall

  • Expand by meeting each tile's building requirements

  • Upgrade buildings into larger, more detailed versions

  • Enjoy a warm living-city atmosphere with pedestrians, lighting, and city growth
